_comment: Property-panel knobs that exist in config.json but are never read by the
component. Each one is a control an App Studio author can set that does
nothing. Recorded 2026-09-06 so the check passes on the existing tree and
This list must only shrink. Fixing a component means either wiring the
prop up or deleting it from config.json, then removing its entry here —
the 'no stale entries' test enforces that.
